addRoute(address).details: ensure routeAddress is a verified bridge or middleware implementation address

params.routeAddress: The address of bridge or middleware implementation contract deployed

returns._0: Id of the route added to the routes-mapping in socketGateway storage

params.routeId: The Id of route-implementation in the routes mapping
routeId is the key in the mapping for routes

addRoute(address).notice: Add route to the socketGateway This is a restricted function to be called by only socketGatewayOwner

disableRoute(uint32).notice: disable a route by setting ZeroAddress to the entry in routes-mapping identified by routeId as key. This is a restricted function to be called by only socketGatewayOwner

getRoute(uint32).notice: Get routeImplementation address mapped to the routeId
